quarterly_data.signal: Xinfeng high-layer PCB production project (annual report, major non-equity investments): approved by the board on February 15, 2023; total planned investment about RMB 30 hundred million, of which fixed-asset investment is expected to be about RMB 20 hundred million or more; located in the Shenzhen Industrial Park in Xinfeng County on about 328 mu of land with 22 ten-thousand square metres of floor space, run by a wholly owned subsidiary; phase 1 went into production in January 2025.
